brief.name: Three physical routes
brief.purpose: Copper, fiber and radio path thumbnails converging on the same known-good endpoints
brief.plannedMethod: Actual OpenAI base imagery with preserved original output; all exact labels/values in semantic UI, with manual diagrams/edits truthfully recorded

binding.alt: A braided copper lead, a glass fiber and two facing radio dishes span the same two endpoint posts.
binding.caption: Lift Sender A and Workshop Receiver B are known good in this exercise. A copper, fiber or radio route can join the endpoints if its own physical requirements and validation checks pass.

conversion: Scale the full uncropped frame with Lanczos and encode RGB WebP at quality 88, method 6. No retouching or labels in the derivative.
